unit.why: Genealogical endnotes on the family of R. Elimelech, R. Zusya and the Maggid of Mezritch: tombstone inscriptions, name corrections and lineage chains. They contain only a habitual remark on the charity of Elimelech's mother and a reported saying about the scent of Paradise at the Anipoli graves, with no narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: Part of a continuous run of numbered genealogical notes; note (כה) continues in the next division.
